goal.en: Use the verbs English actually pairs with everyday nouns: make, do, have, take and get.
goal.ar: أن تستخدم الأفعال التي تقترن فعلاً بالأسماء اليومية في الإنجليزية: make وdo وhave وtake وget.

text.en: Arabic uses «يعمل / يفعل» for both, so this pair has to be learned as English word partnership, not translated.
text.ar: العربية تستخدم «يعمل/يفعل» للاثنين، لذلك يُتعلَّم هذا الفرق بوصفه تلازماً إنجليزياً لا بالترجمة.

text.en: make = create or produce something new. do = perform work, a task or an activity.
text.ar: make للإنشاء وإنتاج شيء جديد، وdo لأداء عمل أو مهمة أو نشاط.

text.en: “Make your homework” and “do a mistake” are both wrong, and both are extremely common. Learn the pair, not the verb.
text.ar: جملتا make your homework وdo a mistake خطأ، وهما شائعتان جداً. احفظ الزوج كاملاً لا الفعل وحده.

text.en: Both “have a shower” (British) and “take a shower” (American) are correct. Pick one and stay consistent.
text.ar: كلٌّ من have a shower البريطانية وtake a shower الأمريكية صحيحة. اختر واحدة والتزم بها.

text.en: You take an exam when you sit it; you pass an exam when you succeed. “I passed the exam yesterday but failed” makes no sense in English.
text.ar: نقول take an exam بمعنى «أدّى الامتحان»، وpass an exam بمعنى «نجح فيه». فالخلط بينهما يقلب المعنى تماماً.

text.en: With a place, “get to” means arrive — but home, here and there take no “to”: I got home, not “I got to home”.
text.ar: مع الأماكن تعني get to «يصل»، لكن كلمات home وhere وthere لا تأخذ to، فنقول I got home لا I got to home.

items.en: I get tired in the afternoon.
She got a new job last month.
items.ar: حصلت على وظيفة جديدة الشهر الماضي.

items.en: What time do you get to the office?

questions.sentence: Be careful — don't ___ the same mistake again.

explanation.en: The fixed pair is “make a mistake”.
explanation.ar: التلازم الثابت هو make a mistake.

questions.sentence: She has to ___ her homework before dinner.

explanation.en: Homework is a task you perform → do.

questions.sentence: The manager will ___ a decision on Monday.

explanation.en: A decision is created, not performed → make a decision.
explanation.ar: القرار يُصنع لا يُؤدَّى، فنقول make a decision.

prompt.en: Which verb goes with each phrase?

explanation.en: make = produce something new · do = carry out an activity · take a photo and have breakfast are fixed pairs.
explanation.ar: make لإنتاج شيء جديد، وdo لأداء نشاط، أما take a photo وhave breakfast فتلازمان ثابتان.

options: He makes a lot of noise.
I must make my homework tonight.

explanation.en: Homework takes “do”: I must do my homework tonight.
explanation.ar: الواجب يأخذ do. الصواب I must do my homework tonight.

questions.sentence: Let's ___ a break for ten minutes.

explanation.en: The fixed pair is “take a break”.
explanation.ar: التلازم الثابت هو take a break.

explanation.en: Meals go with “have”: have breakfast, have lunch, have dinner.
explanation.ar: الوجبات تأخذ have مثل have breakfast وhave lunch.

questions.sentence: Can I ___ a photo of you?

explanation.en: English takes photos; it does not make them.
explanation.ar: الإنجليزية تقول take a photo ولا تقول make a photo.

prompt.en: “I took the exam but I didn't pass.” What happened?

options: He sat the exam and failed it.
He refused to sit the exam.

explanation.en: “Take an exam” = sit it. “Pass an exam” = succeed. They are not the same verb.
explanation.ar: take an exam تعني أداء الامتحان، وpass an exam تعني النجاح فيه. وهما فعلان مختلفان.

prompt.en: Which verb goes with each phrase?

explanation.en: These pairings are fixed: take a break, have a good time, make an effort, do exercise.
explanation.ar: هذه تلازمات ثابتة: take a break وhave a good time وmake an effort وdo exercise.

questions.sentence: Close the window — it's ___ cold in here.

options: I got to the station at eight.
I got to home very late.

explanation.en: “Home” takes no preposition: I got home very late.
explanation.ar: كلمة home لا تأخذ حرف جر. الصواب I got home very late.

options: The children get tired after school.
I get the bus at eight.
We get to work by nine.

explanation.en: get + adjective = become. The others mean take, receive and arrive.
explanation.ar: get مع الصفة تعني «يصبح»، أما البقية فتعني يستقل، ويستلم، ويصل.

questions.answer: What time do you get home

explanation.ar: get home بلا حرف جر قبل home.

prompt.en: Complete with make or do: “Could you ___ me a favour?”
prompt.ar: أكمل بـ make أو do: Could you ___ me a favour?

explanation.en: “Do someone a favour” is fixed — a favour is something you perform for another person.
explanation.ar: العبارة الثابتة هي do someone a favour، لأن المعروف شيء تؤديه لغيرك.

prompt.en: You want your colleague to look at a document. What sounds most natural?
prompt.ar: تريد من زميلك أن ينظر في مستند. ما الأكثر طبيعية؟

options: Could you have a look at this when you get a chance?
Could you make a look at this when you take a chance?
Could you do a look on this when you have chance?
Could you take a look on this when you get chance?

explanation.en: “Have a look at” and “get a chance” are the fixed pairings. (“Take a look at” is also correct — but not “take a look on”.)
explanation.ar: التلازم الصحيح هو have a look at وget a chance. وتصح أيضاً take a look at، لكن لا تصح take a look on.
